product_definition.current_plain_language_loop: model writes finished local-language copy -> TCJ asks whether a human editor would publish this exact copy unchanged -> SHIP or REVISE -> if REVISE, same model edits the current draft using the smallest useful bounded instruction -> TCJ can check again
product_definition.revise_definition: any meaningful edit is required before publication, including shortening/compression, restructuring, house-voice correction, removal of generic/model-like elaboration, stance/certainty correction, or semantic/pragmatic correction

rewrite_lift_v4.interpretation: full pre-rewrite TCJ guidance transferred recognizable house voice but often over-directed and elaborated

selective_editor_v5.interpretation: v5 REVISE was defined too narrowly; it accepted copy the human editor would still shorten/edit before publication

v6_preflight_human_definition_gate.source: the 11 frozen v5 human Needs revision cases
v6_preflight_human_definition_gate.human_clarification: all 11 were too long/over-elaborated; shortening and editing the copy is revision, so a separate VOICE_POLISH state does not match the human editor mental model
v6_preflight_human_definition_gate.architecture_consequence: retain binary SHIP/REVISE but redefine REVISE around actual publication editing rather than only severe semantic defects

v6_settled_contract.ship: the native editor would publish the exact finished draft unchanged
v6_settled_contract.revise: the native editor would make any meaningful edit before publication
v6_settled_contract.revision_behavior: give the writer the current finished draft plus the smallest useful correction; preserve what works; when overlong/generic, shorten rather than add; do not invite fresh composition from the semantic source

validation.gate_question: does TCJ predict whether the human would publish the raw model draft unchanged?
validation.revision_value_question: when revision is needed, does the targeted edit improve publishability without v4-style elaboration?

tcj.next_action: CODEX_IMPLEMENTATION: inspect canonical GitHub+Supabase first, preserve v4/v5 evidence and workers, implement v6 separately under the settled binary SHIP/REVISE contract, create and freeze a new fresh semantic-skeleton bank, run free Gemini only, then stop at a new blind native-human review gate. Never touch Qualification 2.0 or spend paid frontier credits.
